events.name: Atlanta AI Week – Community Day & Startup Showcase

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI Leadership Summit

Produced by the Enterprise Technology Association, the event brings together enterprise leaders, founders, practitioners, and investors focused on real-world AI adoption and implementation across industries.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI Leadership Summit

Produced by ETA and partnered with TAG Georgia, this is the Southeast's largest enterprise AI gathering with attendees from Fortune 500 companies, startups, and policy organizations.

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI for Business Summit

events.name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days | Atlanta

events.name: Atlanta AI Week – AI for Business Summit

events.name: GitHub Copilot Dev Days | Atlanta

events.name: Chapter Meeting: AI & Digital Transformation

events.name: The Jury Experience – Death by AI: Will Atlanta Deliver Justice?
